mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary and fiscal policy responses, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a severe economic contraction that triggers aggressive central bank and fiscal policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-housing bust regime (HOUST below 1000 thousand units), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns due to anticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary easing, as the market prices in policy responses to the housing collapse.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST is below 1000 thousand units, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) level below 100 (2017=100) signals a severe economic contraction that triggers aggressive policy responses, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) signals stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) relative to historical averages signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
